title: (No AI) VisionQuest is what happens when AI really goes rogue
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
![Four characters from VisionQuest are seated on a couch in a living room.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/107-90190_RC.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

In Marvel's _VisionQuest_, a superpowered robot tries to better understand humanity by getting lost in elaborate, digital daydreams in which he and other artificial intelligence-powered beings live together in a home. The series is deeply fantastical, yet it plays with some of the ideas that have come to dominate the conversation about real-world generative artificial intelligence, exploring whether we should look at thinking machines as people and if AI truly poses the kind of existential danger that should keep us up at night. It's also a reminder how aggressively Silicon Valley has used the trappings of science fiction to sell us on its AI …

title: (No AI) Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/gettyimages-2280291188.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Anthropic cofounder and CEO Dario Amodei. | Bloomberg via Getty Images

Anthropic wants to have it both ways. With its impending IPO, it wants to [tap the vast riches of the public markets](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018476/anthropic-ipo-details-s1-filed-sec) and insists it doesn't want to compromise its core mission of developing AI safely and for the benefit of humanity. But greater model capabilities bring greater risks, and shareholders eager for returns may have little patience for costly safety measures that slow products on their way to market.

Sam Altman, the CEO of Anthropic's archrival, OpenAI, has [cited](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1002505/sam-altman-openai-ipo-devday-ai-safety) investor pressures as one reason the company is not pursuing an IPO this year. Anthropic hopes it can resist investor pressures with a mind-boggling governance structure.

…
